title: Basic SQL Injection
description: This web application has a vulnerable login form. Find a way to bypass authentication and login as admin to retrieve the flag.
hints: Try common SQL injection payloads in the login form
Look for ways to make the SQL query always return true
The admin user has special privileges
learning_objectives: Understand the importance of parameterized queries
solution: Use SQL injection payload like 'admin' OR '1'='1'--' in the username field to bypass authentication
writeup: SQL injection occurs when user input is directly concatenated into SQL queries without proper sanitization. In this case, the application constructs the query using string formatting, allowing attackers to manipulate the SQL logic. The payload 'admin' OR '1'='1'--' breaks out of the string context and adds a condition that always evaluates to true, effectively bypassing the password check.
